column4: A single game sprite in EXACTLY the pixel style, palette and grain of the reference image (a 1990s Build-engine game's corn stand counter): the small white enamel butter dish with melted yellow butter and a wooden basting brush lying in it, the one you see on the reference counter, but alone, seen from above at a steep three-quarter angle (as a person standing behind the counter sees it), its sides and depth visible, centred, filling 70 percent of the picture. Chunky pixels, strong simple shading, low saturation. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no shadow, no counter, no text, no border.
